question: what's our total revenue this month?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(j.credit-j.debit),0) FROM journals j JOIN accounts a ON a.id=j.account_id WHERE a.account_type IN ('OPERATING_REVENUE','NON_OPERATING_REVENUE') AND j.post_date>='2026-06-01' AND j.post_date<'2026-07-01'
